steps.name: Beynon's Request (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Merimel] in “Kali,” report the quest to [Baynon].

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Adventurer, thank you again for telling us a story from another continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nice to talk to Merrymel too.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: But Medea is often away, so something dangerous must be happening, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, how should I explain it… . Don't worry too much though. Medea and I will resolve everything.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Adventurer said it was okay... .
(Merimel smiles brightly and holds %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: It'll be okay, right? The Kali people all believe in Adventurer. Because I trust you. If you need anything, please let me know anytime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Uh, Baynon?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Merrymel, I apologize for interrupting the conversation. Wait, %s has some business to attend to... . If there's still something left to talk about, I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: No. My story is over. By the way, is the patrol over?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Adrika seemed okay so she came back.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Then, %s, please talk to Beynon. I'm going to go organize the materials I gathered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baynon, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I have something urgent to say. Let’s go to the village entrance, where I always stood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are you trying to say? Should we just go?)

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You… , I think I went to a place called Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Medea tell you?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: No… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I just remembered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Remember?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You may have heard my story at least once during your visit to Kali Village.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I'm telling my story, which may be the first or the second.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Remember….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Then let me hear it.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: When I was young, I always felt a sense of alienation even when I was with Merrymel and other villagers.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Then an ominous memory came and tormented me. The reason I remain intact is thanks to Medea’s power… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Memories of my family sacrificed by the Deimos Church and me, who collapsed as my vitality disappeared while running to escape their ‘shackles’… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: It is a memory from a past life.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: However, it seemed like there was another memory. After you and Medea came back, there was an inexplicable nostalgic smell.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Knossos… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I’m not sure why I thought of Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Baynon… . What does the Kali have to do with Knossos?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I don't know exactly. My memories and the past of the Kali people... . I also really want to know. Medea would like to know too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you get me some tears of light?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: No, I need something from Knossos. Get me the stone tablet with the wing symbol engraved on it. It must be somewhere important.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Important place… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: help me

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I will go to Knossos.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, an important place would be the Heart's Memories, or Acro's Coffin...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talos told me to come visit often, should I give it a try? Phew, then let’s go.)

steps.name: Beynon's Request (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Pasiphae] in 「Memory of the Heart」 and obtain <Wing Pattern Slate>. Then report the quest to [Baynon] in “Kali.”

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As expected, you seem to be very interested in me. I never thought it would come so quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They told me to visit often and build trust. I didn’t feel like it, but… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Don't deny that you came to take what you need from me, whether you feel like it or not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Although it's true... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a bit annoying... But he's not someone to be taken lightly.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Now, tell me.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: There's nothing we can do if you don't want to talk about it. It's time to go pull the grass.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then have you ever seen a stone with a wing pattern engraved on it?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hmm, why do you need that? Did she ask you to bring it? Well, it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ask the cat woman trapped in the heart's memory to find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking about Pasiphae?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yeah, that girl. Maybe I'm lucky, but I'm the type of person who finds rare things quickly. Anyway, it's so noisy.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They're making a fuss inside trying to get out, but it's so noisy. If the Beast King and that woman come back, they will definitely try to kill me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone who knows that well... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I don't want to talk about it to strangers. Because things are the way they are here.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What are you doing? Go. Go back to the memories of your heart before she destroys everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yeah, good luck.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Hello, hello!
(Pasiphae, who was sitting and lying on a tree, sees %s and jumps down as if she is happy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Pasiphae. Are you resting?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: … I want to get out, but I can't find a way out, so I'm just hanging out here. Wouldn't the answer come out as we play?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: We're bored because we can't even see each other. I was thinking of just searching everywhere and going to sleep, but you came.
(Pasiphae’s eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Did you find a way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. However, I will try my best to find it.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I didn't have high expectations anyway. If it were going to be easy, I would have gotten out of it already.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: And find him... . I don’t have to tell you the rest, right?
(Pasiphae grins and holds up two daggers.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I needed something so I came to find it.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I don't have any more heart pieces, what else do I need? Is that what the goddess needs?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can talk to Pasiphae, so I briefly explain the Kali people and the situation.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: … Daphne's village?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Are you saying that the people trying to remember Knossos are similar to me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But, they don't have tails.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: my tail? This is fake. You can take it off and stick it on! Hehehe, we made it ourselves.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, really?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Why are you so surprised? Anyway, you! You need a wing pattern stone tablet, right? I have that! I'll give it to you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, thank you!

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But I won't just give it to you. It's good because I was bored. Come fight with me! Let's fight just enough not to die! Yeah, huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: It's no fun if you just give it away, so I'll wait at the end of my heart's memory~. Meet me there and let’s fight!

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Then the story ends! Hehehe.
(Pasiphae's eyes sparkle and she walks quickly into the memory of her heart.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I had a good time. Did you take care of the slate I dropped?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: After running for a while, I felt a little better. I was already depressed and thought I was going to die.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Thank you... For working hard for your people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are the Kali people the same people? However, this place is a prisoner’s… .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: What do you think Suin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: You understand that it is a being that walks like a human, but has the appearance of an animal, right?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: There are two types of residents in Creed. It has the face of an animal, walks like a human, is not much different from a human, but only has animal ears... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: As if they were just residents, just life.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: They just look a little, very slightly different from ordinary humans like you, but why are Freios humans so special? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: No need to be serious. I'm used to it.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Anyway, give it to someone who needs it. Come again next time, okay? If you happen to go see him, tell him I miss you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. See you later then. To Pasiphae.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Oh, that's right. There is one more slab... . That's enough, otherwise I'll come back one more time. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But what are we doing? .
